text: In XXXX I was contacted by Wells Fargo advisors who offered me Accidental disability protection. In XXXX I was called again to upgrade my existing policy which I did, adding on Accident protector bonus. Between XXXX I never received any documentation that these policies were no in effect. In XXXX my son XXXX XXXX in an auto accident, and I reached out to Wells Fargo to access the benefits under the Accident protector plan and was advised that I did not have such a coverage as Wells Fargo did not offer this type of insurance. I explained to the representative that I had purchased this years ago and it was a rider on my policy, they again advised that no such services were available. On XX/XX/XXXX, I received the attached letters from Wells Fargo. I called the customer service department and was advised that they did an audit and found that many customers were sold these policies, and they are no longer available. I am reporting them as I am exhausted with getting ripped off by them. They owe me more than a measly {$2000.00}. they owe me more like {$100000.00} for a payout from when my son passed on this policy, they do not have any information for the broker on these policies they only provided the name of XXXX XXXX XXXX and XXXX XXXX XXXX, Please assist.
